screens.heading: The $100,000 Crossroads
screens.body: You are 18 years old. Society tells you to go to the best college possible, no matter the cost. You have 100 'Joy Points' representing your mental health and alignment with your passion. Let's see how your choices look at age 30.

screens.prompt: Phase 1: Select your Academic Major and Institutional Path. Notice the cost vs. your intrinsic passion profile:

options.text: STEM Degree (In-State Public Uni) | Cost: $25K/yr | Passion: Moderate (+10 Joy)
Fine Arts Degree (Elite Private Uni) | Cost: $65K/yr | Passion: Extremely High (+50 Joy)
Humanities Degree (Out-of-State Public) | Cost: $45K/yr | Passion: High (+30 Joy)

screens.prompt: Phase 2: Funding Mix. Slide to determine how much of your annual tuition is covered by standard Student Loans. The remainder is covered by working part-time or family help.
